tables.name: Leadership
tables.description: Who is in charge at present. With the Government priority, 91-100 are rerolled.

results.name: Town Council
results.description: Prominent members of the community were chosen to lead the town collectively. (Free Location: Non-Commercial - Town Hall)

results.name: Mayor
results.description: The locals democratically voted for their current leader.

results.name: Hereditary
results.description: A non-elected leader is in power, by virtue of their bloodline.

results.name: Merchant Monarch
results.description: The wealthiest shop owner in the town leads by default. (+2 to your commercial locations number)

results.name: Military Rule
results.description: The town is controlled by a current or ex-leader of a military group. (+1 to law enforcement roll)

results.name: Oligarchy
results.description: A few individuals hold sway, collectively, over the town. [Roll 1d4]: 1: merchants (plutocracy); 2: mages (magocracy); 3: priests (theocracy); 4: other small group. (Free Location: Non-Commercial - choose one appropriate type and roll on that table)

results.name: Underworld or Criminal Enterprise
results.description: A criminal, or group of criminals, either publicly, or privately, controls the town. (-1 to crime roll) Rerolled with the Government priority.

results.name: Anarcho-Syndicalist Commune
results.description: The members of the town take turns as a sort of executive officer for the week. Rerolled with the Government priority.
